subject: Error in creating as.telemetry() with MOVE object

messages.author: 87667f6309b861b1
messages.subject: Error in creating as.telemetry() with MOVE object
parts:
Hi Chris,

I have a dataset that is tracking eagle movements. I have a single individual in this particular track and I manually converted it to a move object below, which gives me a great plot of its movements:

eagles <-  move(x=track_3290$location.long, y=track_3290$location.lat, time= as.POSIXct(track_3290$timestamp, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz="UTC"),  proj=CRS("+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84"), animal=track_3290$individual.local.identifier)

but when I run as.telemetry() I receive the following error:

> eagles.at <- as.telemetry(eagles)
Minimum sampling interval of 1 seconds in unknown
Error in sp::spTransform(x, sp::CRS(to)) :
  coordinate operation creation from WKT failed: (null)

I have uploaded and redownloaded my data from Movebank to attempt to fix it, but that gave me the same error. 

Thank you!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Error in creating as.telemetry() with MOVE object
parts:
Hi Alida,

That code looks fine and I've never seen that error before. If you can send me a copy of a dataset, then I can take a look at it.
Does as.telemetry work on the track_3290 data.frame?

Best,
Chris
